one_liner: Issue tracking and project planning tool for software teams, with a public GraphQL API.
notes: Docs state personal API keys + OAuth2 (OAuth actor authorization and app manifests are variants of OAuth2, not separate methods). Pricing table lists 'API and webhook access' as Included on the Free plan, so self_serve_free. Official remote MCP at mcp.linear.app (documented on linear.app/docs/mcp). No app review is needed for OAuth apps to work. Nothing ambiguous.

evidence.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Linear's public API is built using GraphQL.
Read-write access is provided through https://mcp.linear.app/mcp by default.
Visit Security & access settings to create and manage them.
